Hey there,

Just wanted to take a moment to drop you a line and let you know how much I appreciated the fresh herbs I noticed in your garden the other day! I’ve been trying to get my own herb garden going but haven't had much luck yet. Your basil, especially, looked so lush and vibrant, it really made my day. I’m thinking of stopping by to see if I can pick up a few sprigs for cooking tonight. Would that be okay?

Thanks again for sharing your bounty with the neighborhood. Hope you're doing well!

Best,
[Your Name] 🌿👩‍🌾
